explanation: The Erdős–Moser conjecture: for A the primes, limsup f(n) = ∞. Because indices start at 1, Nat.nth Nat.Prime 0 = 2 is never used, so 2 is excluded from the consecutive sums. This changes f(n) by at most 1 (at most one representation starts at a given index), so the limsup is unaffected. The statement is faithful and open.
